capabilities: Create and edit Excalidraw drawings saved as Markdown files
Embed drawings into notes with width, alignment, and auto-export options
Link and transclude vault notes, including block references to parts of images
Import images, SVG files, and markdown documents; export drawings as PNG, SVG, or PDF
Automate drawings with the ExcalidrawAutomate scripting engine
extras: The README includes a detailed security/privacy disclosure explaining the plugin's network access, dynamic code execution, and permission-scanner findings. Extensive documentation lives outside the README (plugin wiki, NotebookLM workbook, free Essentials course, and video walkthroughs). The author accepts Ko-fi donations for this one-person project, and a beta community offers more frequent updates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sketch or draw diagrams that are stored in the vault, link to notes, and embed back into Markdown documents.

requires.name: AI provider keys and Taskbone OCR key
Obsidian Sync subscription for full file history and device sync

summary: Visual note-taking plugin that integrates the Excalidraw sketching tool for creating, editing, embedding, and linking drawings stored in the vault.
